en.headline: Truck catches fire on Tuen Mun Highway, driver escapes unhurt
en.dek: The fire broke out around 3:39pm on the Kowloon-bound lanes near Tuen Mun Town Plaza; firefighters extinguished it by about 4pm with no injuries reported.
body: A truck caught fire on the Tuen Mun Highway on Friday afternoon, prompting temporary lane closures but causing no injuries.

Police and the Fire Services Department responded to a report at about 3:39pm of a vehicle fire on the Kowloon-bound carriageway near Tuen Mun Town Plaza. The driver left the vehicle and was unhurt. Firefighters arrived and brought the blaze under control by around 3:57pm.
The Transport Department said some lanes and a slip road to Tuen Fat Road were closed for a period, leading to congestion. The cause of the fire remains under investigation.
Witnesses described thick smoke and flames from the cargo area and cab. Online footage showed the vehicle stopped with hazard lights flashing as the fire intensified.

zh.headline: 屯門公路貨車起火 司機及時逃生無人受傷
zh.dek: 事發下午3時39分左右，往九龍方向近屯門市廣場路段，消防約4時將火勢救熄，部分行車線一度封閉。
body: 周五下午，屯門公路往九龍方向近屯門市廣場對開有貨車起火，司機及時逃生，無人受傷。
警方及消防處接報，事發約下午3時39分。司機走出車外並無受傷。消防員到場後於約3時57分將火勢救熄。
運輸署表示，因車輛著火，部分行車線及通往屯發路的支路一度封閉，導致交通擠塞。起火原因仍有待調查。
目擊者形容現場濃煙及烈焰從貨斗及車頭冒出。網上片段顯示貨車停在行車線上，死火燈閃爐，火勢猛烈。
